content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a game-changer for digital creators locked out of conventional payment processors. It's about sovereignty – your infrastructure, your code, and your customer data. No more reliance on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. No more platform fees, no more rate limits, and no more fear of account suspension. With this architecture, you own your store, your customers, and your data from day one.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here's the nitty-gritty: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. The result is a seamless, end-to-end experience for customers and sellers alike, with real-time order processing, instant delivery, and full data ownership.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale – now you can save 9.5% with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

NOWPayments is the linchpin, with 300+ cryptocurrencies supported and a 0.5% fee. It integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, automating on-chain crypto payment verification and triggering instant deliveries. Supabase or Google Sheets handle order storage, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensure secure file delivery. This is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure designed for scalability and security.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

First, choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Deploy in 48 hours, with 30-day support included. Next, integrate NOWPayments and configure your delivery workflow. Finally, populate your store with products, and watch your customers enjoy seamless, instant experiences. You can find everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) – all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, worth $348 separately.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a game-changer for digital creators locked out of conventional payment processors.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, start by choosing your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. Deploy in 48 hours, and integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing. Configure your delivery workflow, and populate your store with products. Finally, secure your infrastructure with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, and test your stack end-to-end. With the Complete Builder Kit, you have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my existing infrastructure?

Integrating NOWPayments is straightforward, with API documentation and developer support available. You'll need to set up your crypto payment processing workflow, and configure your delivery logic to trigger instant file downloads. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll find detailed guides and templates to help you get started.
What happens if I need to scale my infrastructure?

Scalability is built-in, with this architecture designed for growth. As your sales increase, you can simply upgrade your stack or add new components to handle the demand. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll find scaling playbooks and best practices to help you optimize your infrastructure for success.
Can I use this architecture for other digital products, beyond ebooks and courses?

Yes, this architecture is designed to support any digital product, from templates and fonts to software and plugins. Simply integrate your product delivery workflow, and configure your crypto payment processing to suit your needs.
How do I secure my infrastructure against account suspension or rate limits?

Security is paramount, with this architecture designed to protect your infrastructure from platform risks. Use SPF, DKIM, and DMARC to secure your email, and configure rate limiting and IP blocking to prevent abuse. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll find security best practices and templates to help you optimize your infrastructure for security.
Can I customize this architecture to suit my specific needs?

Yes, this architecture is highly customizable, with API documentation and developer support available. You can integrate new components, configure workflows to suit your needs, and optimize your infrastructure for performance and security.
